title: Zeelandia: The Pirate's Son Who Drove the Dutch Out of Taiwan
summary: This episode tells how, from sixteen sixty-one to sixteen sixty-two, the Ming loyalist commander Koxinga (Zheng Chenggong) besieged the Dutch East India Company's Fort Zeelandia on Taiwan for nine months and accepted the surrender of Governor Frederick Coyett. It covers the Dutch musketeers routed at Baxemboy, the envoy pastor Hambroek, who returned to the fort and was later executed, the relief fleet scattered by a storm, and the Utrecht redoubt, which fell when a German sergeant switched sides. It then follows Koxinga's death a few months later and Coyett, who was blamed in Batavia and exiled to Banda, and his defense, Neglected
